relevance_note: Case report of two boys with LAMP2 variants and Danon disease, plus two previously published LAMP2 patients in Table 1: "Here we report two male infants with early-onset hypertrophic cardiomyopathy".
method_note: Read in full by hand; a Python script in scratch only assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and spans, then checked every span verbatim. Scope: patient 1 and patient 2 (own cases); mother of patient 1 (affected by HCM, untested, deceased; authors only suspect she carried the LAMP2 variant, so no variant row); father of patient 1 (tested, carries the MYH7 variant; LAMP2 absent per 'absent in other healthy family members'); mother and father of patient 2 (tested; LAMP2 variant not detected in either; mother carries the MYH7 variant). The mother's uncle and grandmother of patient 1 ('died young of unknown causes') and the unnamed 'other tested family members' were left out (no individual facts linking them to the disease, not identifiable). Table 1 has patients as columns (column header row 'Mutation'; identity in the 'Reference' row): columns 1 and 3 are this paper's patient 1 and patient 2; columns 2 (Hedberg Oldfors et al., 2015, 10-year-old girl) and 4 (Yang et al., 2005, 13-year-old boy) are previously published patients labelled 'Table 1 column 2' and 'Table 1 column 4'. Their Table 1 ages are recorded as age at last evaluation/time of report because the paper does not say what event the age refers to. No ' / ' stacked cells in this paper. No table symbols used. Normal findings recorded per D-27 as excluded abnormalities (e.g. 'normal systolic functions' -> reduced systolic function excluded; the mother of patient 2's normal ECG, echocardiography, physical examination and blood biochemistry recorded as written, excluding nothing more specific). 'normal fundus' and 'no intellectual disability' in patient 2 do not exclude the broader checklist items (retinopathy; ID/cognitive/learning composite), left not reported. HCM without an explicit LV-hypertrophy statement (mother of patient 1; Table 1 columns 2 and 4) left LVH checklist not reported. 'decreased muscle strength' (patient 1) and decreased muscle strength / lower limb strength (patient 2) recorded as observed for the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' although proximal distribution is not stated. Variant type for c.467T > G left not reported ('causing a premature stop codon' is not stated as a class; a frameshift also causes one). Patient 1's LAMP2 zygosity not stated. Patient 1 vital status: death stated ('patient 1 died at a very young age of 4 months'); cause of death not explicitly stated (VF, coma, treatment withdrawn), left not reported. Patient 2 vital status not explicitly stated, left not reported. Contradictions/inconsistencies: MYH7 c.5704G > C is said to be 'in exon 4 of MYH7' in Case Presentation but 'in exon 39 of MYH7' in Discussion. Patient 2's age at DD diagnosis is given as '3 months old' in Discussion, whereas the case narrative has HCM diagnosed at 3 months and genetic analysis after presentation at 6 months; recorded as printed. For Yang et al. patient, Table 1 lists 'chronic atrial fibrillation' while the text lists 'non-sustained ventricular tachycardia'; both recorded as observed (not contradictory). Both boys called 'compound heterozygous variants of LAMP2 and MYH7' (variants in two different genes); per-variant zygosity taken only from per-variant statements (LAMP2 hemizygous for patient 2; MYH7 heterozygous for both boys). Typos copied verbatim in Table 1 spans ('Levated', 'Troponin T.lnitial', 'nornal lasma').
